arxiv-2111-07523.title: Distortion Reversal in Aperiodic Tilings Thanks: This work was partially supported by a grant from the Simons Foundation (#322515 to Andrew Vince).
arxiv-2111-07523.creator: Louisa Barnsley, Michael Barnsley, Andrew Vince
arxiv-2111-07523.description: Abstract . It is proved that homeomorphic images of certain two-dimensional aperiodic tilings, such as Ammann-A2 tilings, are recognizable, in both mathematical and practical senses. One implication of the results is that it is possible to search for distorted aperiodic structures in nature, where they may be hiding in plain sight. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 52C20, 05B45 1.

arxiv-2203-04692.title: FragmGAN: Generative Adversarial Nets for Fragmentary Data Imputation and Prediction
arxiv-2203-04692.creator: Fang Fang, Shenliao Bao
arxiv-2203-04692.description: Abstract Modern scientific research and applications very often encounter “fragmentary data" which brings big challenges to imputation and prediction. By leveraging the structure of response patterns, we propose a unified and flexible framework based on Generative Adversarial Nets (GAN) to deal with fragmentary data imputation and label prediction at the same time.

arxiv-2503-14997.title: The fundamental representation of pricing adjustments Thanks: Disclaimer: This article represents the views of the authors alone and not the views of any firm or institution.
arxiv-2503-14997.creator: Benedict Burnett, Ryan McCrickerd, Benjamin Piau
arxiv-2503-14997.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Benedict Burnett, Ryan McCrickerd, Benjamin Piau. This article consolidates and extends past work on derivative pricing adjustments, including XVA, by providing an encapsulating representation of the adjustment between any two derivative pricing functions, within an Itô SDE/parabolic PDE framework. We give examples of this representation encapsulating others from the past 20 years, ranging from a well known option pricing adjustment introduced by Gatheral, to the collection of semi-replication XVA originating from Burgard & Kjaer.

arxiv-2507-13611.title: Dynamic Transmission Line Switching Amidst Wildfire-Prone Weather Under Decision-Dependent Uncertainty
arxiv-2507-13611.creator: Juan-Alberto Estrada-Garcia, Ruiwei Jiang, Alexandre Moreira
arxiv-2507-13611.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Juan-Alberto Estrada-Garcia, Ruiwei Jiang, Alexandre Moreira. During dry and windy seasons, environmental conditions significantly increase the risk of wildfires, exposing power grids to disruptions caused by transmission line failures. Wildfire propagation exacerbates grid vulnerability, potentially leading to prolonged power outages. To address this challenge, we propose a multi-stage optimization model that dynamically adjusts transmission grid topology in response to wildfire propagation, aiming to develop an optimal response policy.

arxiv-2602-17998.title: PHAST: Port-Hamiltonian Architecture for Structured Temporal Dynamics Forecasting
arxiv-2602-17998.creator: Shubham Bhardwaj, Chandrajit Bajaj
arxiv-2602-17998.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Shubham Bhardwaj, Chandrajit Bajaj. Real physical systems are dissipative—a pendulum slows, a circuit loses charge to heat—and forecasting their dynamics from partial observations is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We address the position-only (q-only) problem: given only generalized positions q t q_{t} at discrete times (momenta p t p_{t} latent), learn a structured model that (a) produces stable long-horizon forecasts and (b) recovers physically meaningful parameters when sufficient structure is provided.

pmc-12428792.title: EBUS-TBNA for Diagnosis and Staging of Lung Cancer: A Retrospective Regional Analysis Integrating Clinical and Molecular Data (EXPoSURE Score)
pmc-12428792.creator: Gabriela Marina Andrei, Natalia Motaș, Virginia Maria Rădulescu, Nina Ionovici, Marius Bunescu, Daniela Luminița Zob, Viorel Biciușcă, Florentina Dumitrescu, Eugenia Andreea Marcu, Ramona Cioboată, Mihai Olteanu, Gary F Nieman
pmc-12428792.description: Background/Objectives: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with a high proportion of cases diagnosed at advanced stages. Accurate mediastinal staging is essential to guide optimal therapeutic decisions. This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration (EBUS-TBNA) and to develop a composite clinical–molecular score (EXPoSURE) for risk stratification.

pmc-12494892.description: Typhlitis, also known as neutropenic enterocolitis, is an inflammatory condition primarily affecting the cecum. It is most commonly associated with neutropenia, particularly in patients undergoing chemotherapy or with other forms of immunosuppression. However, rare cases have been described in non-neutropenic individuals.A 53-year-old patient presented to the emergency department with right lower quadrant abdominal pain evolving over the past 24 hours.

pmc-12772556.title: Cost-effectiveness of eliminating hospital understaffing by nursing staff: a retrospective longitudinal study and economic evaluation
pmc-12772556.creator: Christina Saville, Jeremy Jones, Paul Meredith, Chiara Dall’Ora, Peter Griffiths
pmc-12772556.description: BackgroundUnderstaffing by nursing staff in hospitals is linked to patients coming to harm and dying unnecessarily. There is a vicious cycle whereby poor work conditions, including understaffing, can lead to nursing vacancies, which in turn leads to further understaffing. Is hospital investment in nursing staff, to eliminate understaffing on wards, cost-effective?

pmc-13076754.title: Body image and social media as predictors of pregnancy health behaviors
pmc-13076754.creator: Agnieszka Bień, Grażyna Bączek, Beata Pięta, Bożena Kulesza-Brończyk, Dorota Ćwiek, Joanna Grzesik-Gąsior
pmc-13076754.description: Pregnancy is a time of profound physical and psychological change, during which health behaviors can affect maternal and fetal outcomes. This study aimed to examine how body image and perceived media portrayals of pregnancy are associated with health behaviors among pregnant women. A cross-sectional survey was conducted with 921 participants across multiple Polish regions.

pmc-13316010.title: Joint Effect of Workplace Gender Discrimination and Gender Composition on the Mental Well-Being in Korean Workers
pmc-13316010.creator: Yeseo Lee, Jongin Lee
pmc-13316010.description: BackgroundDespite growing evidence on the effects of workplace gender discrimination (WGD) and gender composition on workers’ mental well-being, little is known about how these two factors interact to shape overall well-being. This study aims to investigate the joint effect of WGD and gender composition on the risk of poor well-being among Korean workers.

pmc-13367494.title: Tn3-derived inverted-repeat miniature elements that mobilize antibiotic resistance genes
pmc-13367494.creator: Ryota Gomi, Hirokazu Yano
pmc-13367494.description: Miniature inverted-repeat transposable elements (MITEs) are non-autonomous mobile genetic elements (MGEs) that can be mobilized by transposases provided by the relevant autonomous MGEs. MITEs originating from Tn3-family transposons were previously termed Tn3-derived inverted-repeat miniature elements (TIMEs). Composite transposon-like structures bounded by two copies of TIME, called TIME-COMPs, were shown to mobilize the intervening sequences.

uslaw-usc-t25-s282.title: 25 U.S.C. § 282 — Regulations by Secretary of the Interior to secure attendance at school
uslaw-usc-t25-s282.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s282.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 7 (Education Of Indians). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to make and enforce such rules and regulations as may be necessary to secure the enrollment and regular attendance of eligible Indian children who are wards of the Government in schools maintained for their benefit by the United States.
